I-United Nations ichaza udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ngokuthi "noma yisiphi isenzo sodlame olusekelwe ebulilini oluholela, noma okungenzeka luholele, ekulimaleni ngokomzimba, ngokocansi, noma ngokwengqondo noma ukuhlupheka kwabesifazane, okuhlanganisa izinsongo zezenzo ezinjalo, ukuphoqelelwa noma ukuncishwa inkululeko ngokungenangqondo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kwenzeka emphakathini noma empilweni yangasese.

Njengoba ukuthengwa kwezinto zabantu zokufakelwa kumuntu oshonile noma ozinikele abasaphila kanye nokufakelwa kwe-allogeneic okwalandela kungase kube nezingozi zokuziphatha kanye nezokuphepha kubo bobabili abamukelayo kanye nomnikeli, iziphathimandla zezempilo kufanele zenze ukulawula okuqinile kanye nokwengamela okusebenzayo ukuze zibavikele.

Nabanye abalingani ku-Alliance, iWHO isekela ukuqaliswa kwezwe kwesu leSAFE nokuqiniswa kwamandla kazwelonke ngokuhlola kwe-epidemiological, ukuqapha, ukubhekwa, ukuhlolwa kwephrojekthi kanye nokuqoqwa kwezinsiza okufaka isandla ekuqedeni i-trachoma njengenkinga yezempilo yomphakathi.

Ucwaningo olwengeziwe oluhlanganisa imikhakha eminingi luyadingeka ukuze kuqondwe imiphumela yezempilo efihlekile neyesikhathi eside yokuchayeka emlilweni wequbula kubantu abasengozini (izingane, abantu asebekhulile, abantu abakhulelwe, abantu abanezifo ezingamahlalakhona), ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihlala ziphinde zivezwe kulezi zehlakalo zomlilo wasendle.

Uhlaka lomhlaba wonke "Uhlaka Lomhlaba Wonke lokuhlanganisa inhlalakahle kwezempilo yomphakathi kusetshenziswa indlela yokugqugquzela impilo", oluzama ukwenza bonke abantu bakhule futhi bafinyelele amandla abo aphelele ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo impilo yabo yonke impilo yabo kanye nasezizukulwaneni.

Ku-neurocysticercosis, njengoba ukucekelwa phansi kwama-cysts kungaholela ekuphenduleni kokuvuvukala, ukwelashwa okukhethekile kwesifo esisebenzayo kuyadingeka futhi kungase kuhlanganise izifundo ezinde ezinemithamo ephezulu ye-anthelmintic, kanye nokwelashwa okusekelayo ngama-corticosteroid kanye/noma imithi elwa nesithuthwane, futhi mhlawumbe nokuhlinzwa.

Eminyakeni yamuva nje, izinsimbi zamalungelo abantu emhlabeni wonke bezilokhu zisetshenziswa kakhulu ukusekela nokuthuthukisa izimangalo zomthetho ngabanye kanye nemiphakathi yonke ukuze ohulumeni bezwe baqinisekise inhlonipho, ukuvikelwa kanye nokugcwaliseka kwamalungelo abo ezempilo yocansi kanye nokuzala (Cook et al., 2003).

Ukwethulwa kwesinyathelo kwenzeka ngosuku lokugcina lwemihlangano nabantu abangaphezu kwe-120 abamele Amazwe Angamalungu, abalingani, kanye nonobhala weWHO, ukuchaza indlela eya phambili yePRET, okuhlanganisa nokuthuthukiswa kwemephu yomhlaba wonke yokuqalisa ukulungela ubhubhane lwezifo zokuphefumula.

Ngomhla zingama-27 kuNhlaba, Umhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba Wamashumi Ayisithupha Nesithupha wagunyaza isinqumo sokwenza ukubuyekezwa okuzimele kweMember State Mechanism (MSM) yezigameko, imithi esezingeni eliphansi kanye neyakhishiwe, ukuqinisa isicelo soMqondisi-Jikelele sikaJanuwari 2023 sokwazi ukwenza okuthile kule ndawo ebalulekile.

Ukusebenza kuyo yonke imikhakha nokuqinisekisa ukuvumelana kwezinqubomgomo ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha izindawo ezisekelayo nezivumelayo zezempilo, eziqinisekisa ukuthi ukucatshangelwa kwezempilo kanye nokulingana kuhlanganiswa kuyo yonke inqubo yokuhlela, ukutshalwa kwezimali kanye nezinqumo zenqubomgomo ezingeni lendawo.

Uhlolojikelele: Ukuzinakekela yikhono labantu ngabanye, imindeni kanye nemiphakathi lokuthuthukisa impilo, ukuvimbela izifo, ukugcina impilo, kanye nokubhekana nokugula kanye nokukhubazeka ngokusekelwa noma ngaphandle kosizo lwesisebenzi sezempilo. Njengamanje abantu abayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.6 - ingxenye yomhlaba - abakwazi ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile.

Endimeni yakhe yamanje, uDkt Al Jalahma uhole imizamo emikhulu ephumelelayo, efana nohlelo lokugunyazwa kuzwelonke lwezikhungo zezempilo, ukuguqulwa kwedijithali kweNational Health Regulatory Authority, kanye nemizamo eminingana eholela ekusebenzeni kahle okwandisiwe kanye nokwenza kahle emkhakheni wezempilo.

Iseshini yalo nyaka yoMhlangano Wezempilo Womhlaba wonke izonquma ikusasa eliseduze nelide leWHO, kusukela kuhlelo lohlelomali lweminyaka emibili ezayo, izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nokuxhaswa ngezimali okusimeme kweNhlangano kanye nezinguquko ezibekwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zeWHO kanye nokuziphendulela.

Kuhlanganisa zonke izinhlobo zokuphathwa kabi ngokomzimba kanye/noma ngokomzwelo, ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi, ukunganakwa, ukunganaki kanye nokuxhashazwa kwezentengiselwano noma okunye, okuholela ekulimaleni kwangempela noma okungase kube khona empilweni yengane, ukusinda, ukukhula noma isithunzi esimweni sobudlelwano bomthwalo wemfanelo, ukwethembana noma amandla.

Ukubamba umoya weKomidi leNqubomgomo Nokuxhumanisa (PCC) amalungu abungaza iminyaka engama-50 yeHRP kanye nempumelelo yayo eminingi, iSweden ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain neNorthern Ireland bafunde inothi elilandelayo lokubonga kanye nokuhalalisela emhlanganweni wama-36 weHRP PCC.

Izinyathelo ezibalulekile nezinqumo ezivela emhlanganweni zihlanganisa izincomo zokuqinisa nokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumanisa zikazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana ngokuhlela okuhlangene kanye nokuqapha kanye nokuhlola, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kokuhlinzekwa okusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke.

Kuhlanganisa nokwenza ngcono ukwengamela, ukwenza lula izinqubo zokuthengwa kwempahla kanye nokuhlinzekwa ukuze kubhekwane nanoma yikuphi ukungasebenzi kahle, ukwenza ngcono izinsiza ezifana nokuxhaswa ngezimali okuzinzile, ukuthuthukisa amakhono anekhono abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye nokuqwashisa ngazo zombili izinzuzo kanye nokulimala okungase kube khona kokusetshenziswa kwe-opioid.

Emphakathini, ukuvimbela i-sepsis kusizwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlanzeka ezisebenza ngendlela efanele, ukuthuthukisa ukuhlanzeka kanye nekhwalithi yamanzi kanye nokutholakala kwawo, ukuhlinzeka ngokufinyelela emithini yokugoma, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasengozini enkulu, kanye nokudla okufanele, okuhlanganisa ukuncelisa ibele izingane ezisanda kuzalwa.

Imizamo ihlanganisa ithuluzi elizinikezele labantu asebekhulile, ukwakhiwa kwamandla kwabasebenzi bezokunakekelwa kwabancane abangu-2000, isonto lokukhulumela impilo elizinikele kubantu asebekhulile, kanye nephrojekthi entsha yokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo kanye nengqondo yabantu asebekhulile abangaphezu kwengxenye yesigidi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni nezasemakhaya.
